reason: As a magician the tricks sound cool and I'd definitely grab the free ones, but I'm not putting my card into some website that isn't even in the App Store. I don't pay for apps anyway, so the free tricks will do me for now.
objection: Paying 99 shekels by card on an unknown site for an app installed from the browser feels like it could be a scam, and if it stops working there's no App Store to complain to.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend in my WhatsApp group bought it and showed me the full tricks working, and I could pay with Bit or through Google Play instead of typing my card on their site.
